mapper.select: SELECT sc.student_id AS studentId, ROUND(AVG(sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score), 1) AS total FROM score sc JOIN exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY sc.student_id

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, ROUND(AVG(sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score), 1) AS total FROM score sc JOIN exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id

SELECT bucket AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score >= 90 THEN '90-100' WHEN sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score >= 80 THEN '80-89' WHEN sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score >= 70 THEN '70-79' WHEN sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score >= 60 THEN '60-69' ELSE '<60' END AS bucket FROM score sc JOIN exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id WHERE sc.exam_id = #{examId} ) t GROUP BY bucket

SELECT s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS name, sc.score AS score, e.full_score AS fullScore FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id WHERE sc.exam_id = #{examId} AND sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score < #{threshold} ORDER BY sc.score ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalScores, ROUND(AVG(sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score), 1) AS avgScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS passRate FROM score sc JOIN exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id
AND c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT e.name AS examName, e.exam_date AS examDate, ROUND(sc.score * 100.0 / e.full_score, 1) AS percent FROM score sc JOIN exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY e.exam_date, e.id
